Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 28, 2026

Big Beard Apps ("we," "us," or "our") built Gunmark as a private firearm collection catalog. This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of information when you use our app.

Information We Do Not Collect

Gunmark does not require an account. We do not collect your name, email address, location, or any personally identifiable information through the app.

How the App Works

Gunmark makes zero network calls. There is no server, no API, and no backend of any kind behind the app. Every firearm entry, component, photo, document, receipt, and note you add is stored locally on your device using Apple's SwiftData framework, and it stays there.

  • The app cannot send your data anywhere — it has no networking code at all.
  • Nothing is uploaded, synced to a server we control, or shared with any third party.
  • If you delete the app, your data is gone unless you exported it yourself first.

Photos & Documents

Photos and documents you attach to a firearm or component (receipts, tax stamps, forms) are stored only on your device. Gunmark uses Apple's system photo picker and file picker, which let you choose files without granting the app broad access to your photo library. Attached files are never uploaded anywhere.

Exports

Gunmark can generate a PDF or CSV export of your collection on request. That export is created and saved locally on your device — you choose where it goes from there (for example, AirDrop, Files, or Mail) using Apple's standard share sheet. We have no visibility into, and no copy of, anything you export.

App Lock

If you enable the optional Face ID / Touch ID lock, authentication is handled entirely by Apple's LocalAuthentication framework on your device. Biometric data never reaches Gunmark or Big Beard Apps.

In-App Purchases

Gunmark Pro is a one-time in-app purchase processed entirely by Apple through StoreKit. We do not receive or store your payment information — that relationship is between you and Apple.

The Beta Signup Form (gunmark.app)

The Gunmark app itself collects nothing. Separately, our marketing website at gunmark.app offers an optional beta-signup form for people who want a TestFlight invite. If you choose to fill it out, the name, email address, and message you enter are delivered to us by Formspree (formspree.io), a third-party form service. That form is not part of the app, is entirely optional, and Formspree's privacy policy applies to that submission. No account is created and nothing else is collected.

Analytics

Gunmark does not use any third-party analytics or advertising services. We do not track how you use the app.

Children's Privacy

Gunmark is not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by updating the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us via the contact form.
